name: Private Pilot Made Easy Online Ground School
summary: Video ground school sold as a one-time purchase with lifetime access.
endorsementNote: Says a free written endorsement is issued after 100% of the coursework and 80% or better on two timed practice exams.
guarantee: Says it will send $175 and refund 100% of the course if you do not pass the FAA test on your first try, plus a 30 day satisfaction guarantee.
includes: Over 800 practice questions and several practice exams
A free Airplane Maneuvers Mastery course, which the page values at $149 (the provider's own figure)
watchOut: The page does not say how soon after purchase the first-try guarantee must be claimed.
Third-party comparison articles list different prices for this course; see the disagreement table.
